info.description:
Order processing with reserve-pay-commit inventory, an outbox
relay, and compare-and-swap state transitions throughout.

POST /orders returns 202, not 201: when it returns, stock is
reserved and the order exists, but payment has not happened yet.
Poll GET /orders/{id}/status for the outcome.
info.title: Concurrent Order Processing API

unit_price_cents.description:
UnitPriceCents is a snapshot taken at order time. If this were a join to
products.price, an admin raising a price would retroactively rewrite every
historical order and every past report.

source.description:
Source makes the two halves of the report distinguishable rather than
silently blended: a closed day is a materialised fact, today is a moving
number that will change before the day ends.

pending.description: true when a charge is in flight and the outcome is not yet known

price_cents.description:
Money crosses the wire as integer cents, the same as it is stored. A JSON
float here would reintroduce the rounding the schema exists to avoid.

role.description: Role is accepted only when the caller is already an admin; see below.

version.description:
Version is the optimistic lock. Two admins restocking at once would
otherwise silently overwrite each other's absolute value.
